title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
abstract: arXiv:2611.07723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. translated_abstract: 蛋白质基序支架化基准测试旨在评估生成模型能否在功能重要残基周围构建支架结构，其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及用何种标准定义成功。现有基准通常采用小型人工筛选的基序集合和静态的复折叠评估标准，然而蛋白质功能往往依赖于构象系综与构象转变。本文同时针对基准范围和成功标准两方面进行了改进。我们提出了BILBY-PRO，一个从与PROSITE关联的实验结构中系统推导出来的结构保守功能性基序基准，包含来自174个PROSITE基序模式条目的220个测试案例。对六个近期支架生成模型的评估揭示了它们在目标覆盖率和独特解产出方面的不同模式：RFDiffusion和Proteina能够解决更多目标，而ESM3在其所解决的目标上能产出更多独特的成功支架。我们进一步引入BILBY-MD，一个基于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了动力学感知的蛋白质基序支架化新基准BILBY-PRO和BILBY-MD，通过系统性扩大基序覆盖范围并引入动态稳定性评估标准，揭示了不同生成模型在目标覆盖与独特解产出之间的显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces dynamics-aware benchmarks (BILBY-PRO and BILBY-MD) for protein motif scaffolding, which systematically expand motif coverage and incorporate dynamic stability criteria, revealing distinct trade-offs between target coverage and unique-solution yield across generative models.
